capabilities: Create multiple Markdown notes at once from templates, names, or blanks
Create multiple folders in bulk, optionally populated with blank notes
Generate bullet or numbered index links to notes in a folder
Browse vault folders to select destinations, templates, and target files
Insert invisible heading-based tags that auto-populate from the nearest heading
disambiguation: Not a prose-editing or writing-assistant tool; it handles file management, linking, and tagging, not the writing itself.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents current limits (25 auto-generated notes per folder, 50-action history) and offers support via Buy Me a Coffee and bug reports via Discord.
motivation: The author built it for their own writing projects to automate repetitive file-management tasks useful when building a large writing project.
problem: Building a large writing project in Obsidian involves repetitive file tasks — creating many notes and folders, maintaining index notes, and tagging by heading — that core features handle only one file at a time.
summary: File-management toolkit for novel writing and worldbuilding: batch note and folder creation, index link generation, a folder browser, and invisible heading-based tags.
